aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.
